title: Punch the Clock
author: eohjay
desc: 12 week intermediate hypertrophy program. Filled with movements that I particularly enjoy to reduce mental burnout. No particular goal other than consistency.

ex.note: Grip width so wrists/forearms are above elbows when bar is on chest
Set bench to roughly 45 degree angle.
Pulley at knee to thigh level. Split stance. Pack shoulders down and back. Keep a permanent bend in the elbows. Sweep upwards, squeeze upper pecs.
Pulley at chest level. Split stand, forward lean, proud chest.
Pulley at head height, face away, split stance, slight lean forward. Fix elbows beside head and only move at elbows.
Pulley high, hinge slightly forward, split stance. Pin elbows to side, spread the rope.
Pulley height slightly below chest. Use V handle.
Overhand grip just outside of shoulder width.
Back flat and parallel to floor. Don't twist torso. Hold brief contraction at top.
Very slight forward lean. Drive up and towards back. No rolling. Pause at top.
Pulley at eye level. Pinky's against outside of rope.
Do not lean back.
Maintain slight bend in knees. Neutral spine. Push hips back.
Hinge at 45 degrees or less. Squeeze, don't kick. Pause at top.
Pulley above head. Feet shoulder width apart. Don't pull too low or you'll engage lats.
Pulley around elbow height. Face away. Split stance . Slight lean. Keep elbows locked beside head, unsheathe.
Use V handle.
Very slight forward lean. Drive up and towards back. No rolling. Pause at top.
High knee march.
Dead stop, pause on box. Stay tight and upright. Treat box like glass.
Pause at top. Shins vertical at top. Tuck chin.
Shoulder width stance. Crush your armpits. Slight bend at knees, hips drive back. Stop at hamstring stretch.  Reverse motion by squeezing glutes and hamstrings.

ss.note: Hinge at 45 degrees or less. Squeeze, don't kick. Pause at top.
